lines.speaker: d
lines.text: Seven unknown blips crossed the White House on radar. And the radar was working.

lines.speaker: d
lines.text: An airline pilot saw lights right where the blips were.

lines.speaker: d
lines.text: The Air Force sent fighter jets. Every blip vanished.

lines.speaker: d
lines.text: The jets left. The blips came back.

lines.speaker: d
lines.text: Three radars tracked one target. It vanished from all three at once.

lines.speaker: d
lines.text: The Pentagon's biggest press conference since World War Two blamed warm air bending the radar.

lines.speaker: d
lines.text: A Navy radar specialist said it was too weak.
